entries.claim: Luno (Pty) Ltd is an authorised Financial Services Provider, FSP No. 53314, under FAIS.
Luno (Pty) Ltd is a registered credit provider, NCRCP22123, under the National Credit Act 34 of 2005.
Luno is a wholly-owned, independently-operated subsidiary of Digital Currency Group (DCG), acquired September 2020; formerly named BitX.
entries.source_ref: DCG/Luno acquisition press release (BusinessWire, 2020-09) / PitchBook profile

entries.claim: The majority (~95%) of customer crypto is held offline in multi-signature 'deep freeze' storage managed by BitGo Custody and Fireblocks; hot wallets use multi-sig with dual authorisation.

Luno publishes a monthly Proof of Reserves using the Merkle-tree method under ISRS 4400 (Revised), independently attested by Moore, showing reserves exceeding 100% of customer liabilities at snapshot.
entries.source_ref: Moore AUP PoR reports (e.g. Luno_PoR_OCT25, Luno_POR_January_2025)

entries.claim: Instant Buy/Sell in South Africa is priced at approximately 2% per transaction (separate from Exchange order-book fees).
entries.source_ref: https://guide.luno.com (Luno fees and limits in South Africa)

entries.claim: Luno operates an off-chain internal ledger enabling instant transfers between Luno users.
Luno exposes a public REST API for market data and trading.
FICA Directive 9 (issued 15-Nov-2024, effective 30-Apr-2025) imposes a Travel Rule on CASP crypto transfers with an R5,000 threshold; it applies to CASP<->CASP and CASP<->unhosted-wallet transfers.
entries.source_ref: https://www.fic.gov.za (Directive 9 media release; Public Compliance Communication PCC 61 of 2026)

entries.claim: Luno offers ETH staking with an undisclosed commission take-rate on rewards.
entries.source_ref: Luno staking product page (feature SEEN; take-rate not published)

entries.claim: Luno's mobile application internals (auth token format, certificate pinning, embedded SDK inventory, framework) are unverified.
Luno's on-chain cold/hot custody addresses and any Luno-issued token contract addresses are unverified against a public block explorer.
